messages:
incident-bot: Paging triggered — Endpoint /v1/generate (us-west-2) p95 latency > 1200ms for 5m, error rate up ~0.5%. Pager: @Sam (oncall). Incident ID: INC-20260317-01. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-latency
Sam (oncall): Acknowledged. I'll start triage. Pulling recent histograms and queues now.
Jess (SRE): Initial triage: embedding-proxy queues showing sustained depth; downstream GPUs show normal CPU/GPU util but request backlog at the proxy layer. nginx 502 rate small but latency spike correlates w/ queue depth.
Marco (Runtime): Seeing frequent KV-cache miss storms from a small subset of clients (long-context requests) — causes more work per request and longer LRU churn. Possible mitigation: route large-context requests to dedicated pool or fallback to quantized variant.
Sam (oncall): Can we do quick routing fallback? Prior runbook has config toggle `route_policy.override_large_context=true`.
Marco (Runtime): I can push a short-lived routing rule to divert model variant to `redwood-small-q4` for requests with >4096 tokens. Command: ```curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/policies -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"name":"temp-large-ctx-fallback","match":"seq_len>4096","action":"route:small-q4"}'``` Will monitor effect.
Jess (SRE): Also enabling prefix KV caching for common system prompts might reduce load: `kvcache.enable=true` for model group alpha. Applying now.
Sam (oncall): Applying Marco's routing rule (pushed). Observed initial drop in queue depth within 90s, p95 from 1.3s -> 950ms. Still elevated but improving.
Priya (Comms): Drafting status page update. Suggest short message for customers: "We are investigating increased response times for text generation in us-west-2. Some requests may see higher latency; mitigation in progress. No data exposure. We'll update in 30 minutes." Anyone want to add SLA wording? :megaphone:
Jess (SRE): Customer impact: Affects ~4% of production traffic in us-west-2, primarily long-context enterprise workloads. No error spike visible for embeddings-only endpoints. SLA risk low at this stage but watch error rate.
Sam (oncall): Agree. Priya, go ahead with that update. Use severity: "degraded performance".
Priya (Comms): Posted status: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-20260317-01 — added details and mitigation steps.
Marco (Runtime): After fallback, we should consider rebalancing model variants across pools to avoid concentrated large-ctx churn. Filing follow-up action item.
Jess (SRE): Monitoring for 15m window. If p95 > 1s after that, escalate to infra and consider temporary rate-limit on long-context requests via API layer. Example snippet to enforce: ```if (seq_len > 8192) return 429;```
Sam (oncall): Handing off to night oncall @Dave for 02:00-10:00 PST watch. Dave — current state: p95 ~900ms, queue depth trending down but keep an eye on KV-miss rate and error rate.
Dave (night-oncall): Acked. I'll keep monitoring and will open a follow-up if we revert rollback or see error increases.
Priya (Comms): Sending customer outreach to top 10 affected accounts with personalized note + mitigation ETA ~45m. Template used: "We observed intermittent latency on text generation in US-West; mitigation in progress. No data loss. Engineering investigating root cause; we'll follow up with a post-incident summary."
Sam (oncall): Logging timeline and tagging incident owner for postmortem. Current mitigations: routing fallback + kvcache enabled. Next steps: (1) validate fallbacks don't cause quality regressions, (2) schedule rebalancing, (3) tighten seq_len admission controls.
Jess (SRE): Adding brief commands/logs for handoff: `kubectl logs -n inference proxy-xyz | grep KV_MISS` and `promql: sum(rate(request_queue_depth[1m])) by (shard)`.
Marco (Runtime): Postmortem note: suspect combo of increased long-context traffic from a new customer rollout + slightly stale cache warming from recent model variant churn. Will include in RCA.
Priya (Comms): I'll prepare the customer-facing postmortem draft. Sam, Jess, Marco — please add root-cause bullets tomorrow.
Dave (night-oncall): All set. I'll mark the incident as monitoring and update if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260317-01 status -> monitoring. Metrics: p95 reduced from 1300ms to 850-950ms after routing fallback. Next automated check in 15m.
